description: Governor's Office - North Central Province - Appointed Secretaries to the North Central Province Provincial Council by Governor
categorisation: This gazette contains exclusively government personnel appointments (e.g., "Mr. J. M. R. P. Jayasinghe... acting as the Secretary to the Governor," "Mrs. P. S. Wimalaweera... as the Secretary of the North Central Province"). It names specific individuals and provides their basic titles/positions but does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to which positions without elaborating on what those positions entail in terms of specific duties or policy areas.
